identity_caveats.finding: Experiment prose says OT-Flow (Finlay et al. 2020); reference list p13 contains Onken et al. 2021 OT-Flow. Acquired official EmoryMLIP source is Onken OT-Flow. Do not relabel Finlay regularized CNF as this repository until exact Table2/reference identity is resolved.
De Bortoli et al. DSB official source does not acquire or implement later DSBM-IPF/DSBM-IMF.
Maintainer SimpleRealNVP/MADE components only. Original RealNVP and original MADE paper experiment repositories/settings are not claimed acquired.
Official JAX source is distinct from score_sde_pytorch and from Flow Matching paper same-U-Net loss comparisons.
FFJORD README also supplies Glow/RealNVP comparison scripts; these are FFJORD authors baseline implementations, not the original Glow/RealNVP paper code.
